title: Best pipeline to handle parallel tasks with Claude/GPT and Unreal?
author: SavingClippy
selftext: Given that each prompt can take a long time to process, I wonder if there is a safe way to handle parallel agents without them stomping each other, and without unreal going crazy because of that, specially if touching similar parts of the project. I've seen some generic orchestrators in github, but also seen people complain about increased token usage and overload, so not sure.

comments.author: 3tt07kjt
comments.body:
Separate workspaces, check into version control, merge branches.

If you get merge conflicts you can basically tell the AI, “Hey, there are merge conflicts, resolve them.”

replies.author: SavingClippy
replies.body: Can MCP issues still happen despite of this? Not super familiar with MCP, but I would guess that if it is doing things like changing focus to a animation editor or opening X blueprint or things like that, there can be issues before checking out a file. And merging BPs might be a tricky thing, not sure.

replies.author: 3tt07kjt
replies.body: You have two MCPs, one for each workspace
